name: Lufna
source:
A capricious and independent Russian Blue cat. He may be uncooperative and autonomous, but he's also sensitive to the main character's feelings and, deep down, very considerate. His brusque manner is just a cover. He aims to be the one to vanquish the main character's enemies.

From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/447180/My_Secret_Pets/?curator_clanid=33519001]Steam[/url]
